summary: Hardware SPI bus spi1 (RSPI B channel 1) - the RW007 Wi-Fi module bus.
fsp_note: FSP stack r_spi_b g_spi1 with DTC transfers g_transfer0/1 and the SPI clock (board.clock.spiclk.source = PLL1P) - as in projects/vision_board_wifi/configuration.xml.
readme: Wi-Fi & RW007 example: the RW007 module talks to the MCU over SPI (up to 30 MHz) - SPI1 is that bus
